solution_code.python:
import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import io

def clean_churn_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    res = df.copy()
    res['tenure_months'] = res['tenure_months'].fillna(res['tenure_months'].median())
    res['monthly_charges'] = res['monthly_charges'].fillna(res['monthly_charges'].median())
    q25 = res['monthly_charges'].quantile(0.25)
    q75 = res['monthly_charges'].quantile(0.75)
    iqr = q75 - q25
    upper_limit = q75 + 1.5 * iqr
    res['monthly_charges'] = np.where(res['monthly_charges'] > upper_limit, upper_limit, res['monthly_charges'])
    return res

def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not raw:
        return
    df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(raw))
    out = clean_churn_features(df)
    print(out.to_csv(index=False))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
